summary.disposition: All three class strings end in ellipsis; removing that literal ellipsis yields an exact prefix of the cached detail tooltip.

limitations: Merged top-level tooltips are attributed to primary detail URLs, not automatically to every URL in their source list.
Full published records are retained for research. No operative mechanics, canonical identities, historical dates or missing class text are inferred.
Same-provenance snapshots are not independent corroboration. Modern emulator observations do not establish live-era mechanics.
Absent typed effects and rows without strict class snapshots remain separate coverage work.
